title: Aegesthus
summary: Raleigh names Aegesthus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aegesthus, the sonne of Numitor, slaine by Amulius. He is not a man of the house of Agamemnon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. IV, sig. 348b
